posts.cooked:
The Game Preserve Fashion Mall Commons (Indianapolis, northeast side) has asked me to run a Sentinels of the Multiverse event on Sunday Feb 3rd from noon to 4pm.

 

For now this is a one time thing, but if it goes well, this will likely become a monthly event.

 

Since we already have plenty of meetups for Indianapolis forum-goers, I'm mostly interested to see if the store will advertise this and develop a new set of regular players. Still, you all are more than welcome to come and if you're planning on it, please let me know.
